name: Zacatecas
discoveryMethod: First-party English and Mexican Spanish discovery, state and municipal custodian review, official viewer/login inspection, and bounded public-page/API-route checks.
queryOutcomes: Both discovery languages identified the official state Dirección de Catastro y Registro Público and the municipal Catastro office. Official map PDFs evidence cadastral products for Zacatecas. The official GEOEscritorio exposed a username/password wall, while state/CIEG pages timed out during direct retrieval; no anonymous parcel geometry or schema response was obtained.

sourceAssessment.localCustodian: Presidencia Municipal de Zacatecas, Catastro Municipal, evidenced by the municipal cadastral-services page and official cadastral map title blocks.
sourceAssessment.stateCustodian: Dirección de Catastro y Registro Público del Estado de Zacatecas, evidenced by the official state site, delegation listing, and cartography/cadastre service list.
sourceAssessment.publicService: Official GEOEscritorio at catastropredial.zacatecas.gob.mx/Portal_ZAC/app_Login/ is a cadastral-management/viewer candidate, but its public route is login-protected and no anonymous API configuration was observed.
sourceAssessment.nativeFieldsObserved: None from a safe anonymous feature response; no native parcel identity was retained.
sourceAssessment.compositeKeyProvenance: No composite identity was constructed because no feature response or field schema was obtained.
